scope: Stage 3 actual local parser/canonical/intelligence components and mocked usage preflight; no user capacity claim

acceptance.integrity: Exact parsed counts, all IDs and checksum; canonical total observations and current values; eligible linked source/KPI counts; same digest across repeats
acceptance.resource: No RSS/watchdog/heap/timeout stop; any stop aborts larger cases
acceptance.diagnosticBudget: Per-sample parse+map+canonical <=5000ms, source layer+coverage <=10000ms; these are provisional local benchmark thresholds, not product SLOs
acceptance.percentiles: Nearest rank p50/p95/max; only 5 or 3 samples per dataset, no statistical tail guarantee
acceptance.quota: Positive controls at limit deny; count-query errors should report unavailable or deny; simultaneous distinct requests with one slot left should admit at most one under an atomic quota contract

limitations: CSV observations deliberately repeat dates across 24 months; tests volume integrity, not source reconciliation or unique-period semantics
Import producer series bounded to25; source layer to24; cannot infer high-cardinality limits
RSS monitored externally every100ms; transient overshoot between samples is possible; child maxRSS recorded
No repeated earlier stage test unless new dataset/fault/concurrency
sourceDatasetAmendmentBeforeLargeRun: Confirmed maximize semantics for each of24 series and assert24 emitted findings; preserves earlier unclassified200-file pilot as limited evidence.
